text:
emma: Quick alignment needed: Sales wants BYOK + live audit-search in pilot. Sec/legal pushback. Can we scope a safe MVP that unblocks pilots without expanding blast radius?

rakesh: Engineering note: full BYOK (live-searchable) requires key wrapping + runtime unwrapping path + rotation semantics. That's ~4 sprints to do properly. We can do a read-only BYOK archive export earlier.

ella: Security stance: no live-search against customer keys in prod during beta. Risk: memory/kv cache could leak plaintext if unwrapping occurs on nodes with multi-tenant processes. We can allow managed-key live-search + BYOK archive exports. :no_entry:

tom: Sales: the pilot needs auditors to be able to query logs interactively during their window. If we force export-only, customer says it's a blocker. Can we offer a temporary workaround: a dedicated VM that runs export+search under escrowed unwrap key for the audit window?

jess: Legal: temporary unwrapping under escrow is acceptable only with very narrow SLA and written consent. Need an audit trail and signed attestation that keys were used only for that window. Also need indemnity language for us not storing escrowed keys post-window.

rakesh: Technical approach for compromise:
- Phase 1 (beta, managed-search): ship audit streaming + search using Redwood-managed KMS; retention controls + legal-hold toggles.
- Phase 2 (BYOK archive exports): implement export-run that can accept a short-lived unwrap token from customer (customer provides) to produce signed, encrypted bundle for auditors. No unwrap in hot path.
- Phase 3 (BYOK live-search pilot): gated, requires dedicated single-tenant runtime, FIPS/HSM-backed unwrap, and sec sign-off.

ella: Add to gating checklist for Phase 3:
- memory zeroization tests for unwrapped payloads
- HSM-backed unwrap with tenant isolation
- penetration test focused on key handling
- documented escalation for key-loss and rotation

emma: Acceptance criteria proposal for Phase 1 (what we can reasonably ship in 2 sprints):
- audit-streaming pipeline with event schema (v1) and per-tenant TTL UI in console
- hot search index for 30d with 2s p95 query SLA validated in perf tests
- legal-hold flag that prevents deletion and marks exports
- export API that produces signed bundles (managed-key)
- internal runbook for auditors + export demo for pilot customers

tom: If we can promise a temporary dedicated-export VM + escrowed unwrap for the pilot, Sales can keep customers engaged while Phase 2 work is ongoing. Need clear contract language and a timeboxed window.

jess: I'll draft a one-pager: escrowed unwrap terms (scope, logging, timebox, attestation). Two points: (1) customer must provide the unwrap token, (2) Redwood will not retain the token after the run; operations will publish a signed attestation of actions.

infra-bot: Created ticket COMPL-3301 "byok-pilot-escrow-unwrap-flow" assigned to @rakesh, @jess, due 5060300000. Link: https://rwd/ticket/COMPL-3301

rakesh: Sizing question: what EPS (events/sec) should we test for exporter VM? Sales pilot expects ~8000 events/day with bursts up to 10k/hour. I'll size for 3x headroom: target 30k/hour sustained for export window.

emma: Product decision: proceed with Phase 1 as default for all customers; offer escrowed-export option for pilot customers under contract; treat full BYOK live-search as enterprise opt-in after Phase 3 gating.

ella: One more: require an annual tabletop/key-loss exercise for any customer who opts into BYOK live-search. Add to contract as precondition for production eligibility.

emma: Ok — next actions: rakesh to add infra subtasks to COMPL-3301, jess to share escrow one-pager by Tue, ella to list security tests, tom to confirm pilot customer consent to escrow flow. Review Wed sync. :thumbsup:
